subject: stats: replace Copy with ShallowCopy for table stats update logic (#62430)
summary: Reviewed the only behavioral change in `StatsCacheImpl.Update`: switching from `oldTbl.Copy()` to `oldTbl.ShallowCopy()` when histograms are confirmed up-to-date and only table-level meta (version/count/modify_count/TblInfoUpdateTS) is refreshed. The shallow copy is not subsequently used for any column/index map mutations on this path, and mutation paths (e.g. sync-load cache updates and LFU eviction compaction) rely on `Table.Copy()` before changing internal stats objects, so no correctness/concurrency/data-consistency Blocker/High issues found.
